PR06: address re-review: frozen snapshot transforms and fresh parent rebuilds

- PlateViewportPresentation captures the canvas affine transform (pan plus
  the image of the world basis) at snapshot creation and converts through
  pure closures, so an old snapshot no longer silently follows a later
  pan/zoom of the live CanvasKit controller.
- The overlay gate re-runs its stable builder whenever the parent rebuilds
  with a value-equal presentation snapshot, so plain ancestor State values
  (without an InheritedWidget) stay fresh; policy filtering applies only to
  genuinely changed snapshots.
